title: Platform-independent SIMD in Go
summary: A Go blog post exploring an experimental approach to platform-independent SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) in Go, aiming to let developers write vectorized code that compiles across architectures without architecture-specific intrinsics. The Hacker News discussion (389 points, 144 comments) debates performance, portability trade-offs, and comparisons to C/C++ and Rust SIMD support.
